# Setting seed for reproducibility.
set.seed(123)

# 1. Creating a 5 x 10 matrix of random integers
mat <- matrix(sample(1:100, 50, replace = TRUE), nrow = 5, ncol = 10)

# 2. Defining column names
colnames(mat) <- c("cond1","cond2","cond3","cond4","cond5",
                   "ctrl1","ctrl2","ctrl3","ctrl4","ctrl5")

# 3. Defining row names
rownames(mat) <- paste0("gene", 1:5)

# 4. Computing fold change of each gene
fold_change <- rowMeans(mat[,1:5]) / rowMeans(mat[,6:10])

# 5. Viewing the Results
mat
fold_change
